source: ref/nsmb-decomp (CC0 clean-room decompilation, early stage -- not all actors decompiled)

evidence: src/Bases/Coin.cpp:650 sets viewOffset.y = 8 while :705 offsets the sprite by 0x8000 (8 px == 0x8000)
src/Bases/Coin.cpp:517-518 shifts by 0x8000 (half tile) and 0x10000 (tile) => 1 tile = 16 px = 0x10000
units.note: An earlier revision of this project used 16.16 (0x10000 per pixel). That was wrong by 16x and is corrected here.
units.accel_sign: positive velocity.y is UP (src/Bases/manhole.cpp:370-377 tests player.velocity.y > 0 to mean jumping), so gravity is negative and minVelocity.y is the floor.

updateVerticalVelocity.meaning: minVelocity.y is a ONE-SIDED lower clamp: it is terminal fall speed and does not limit upward motion.

updateHorizontalVelocity.rule: velocity.x moves toward minVelocity.x in steps of accelH, snapping on overshoot
updateHorizontalVelocity.meaning: minVelocity.x is an asymptotic TARGET speed, not a limit. Zero callers in src/.

applyAcceleration.rule: per axis, clamp velocity + acceleration to +-velocitylimit
applyAcceleration.meaning: velocitylimit caps the integration STEP, and the clamped value is never written back to velocity. Default +-0x8000 = 32 px/frame, set once in the Actor ctor (src/Bases/Actor.cpp:52-54) and never overridden in src/.

stepVelocityClamped.rule: second, separate clamp family using scalar velH/minVelH/accelV/minVelV, treating them as a two-sided attractor
stepVelocityClamped.meaning: zero callers and zero writers in src/ today. Listed so it is not mistaken for the live path.

constants.note: the only non-zero accelH in the repository
scales whatever the base gravity is; the base value and the caller are NOT in this repository

unknown.player_gravity: Not in the decompilation. The Player hierarchy (PlayerBase : StageActor : Actor : Object) never assigns accelV, minVelocity or velocitylimit, so player gravity is not expressed through the Actor gravity fields at all -- it lives in the player's own movement routine, which is not decompiled yet.
unknown.player_jump: No jump velocity, no button-hold logic, no apex/hang-time and no per-jump-state branching exists anywhere in src/. Grep for 'jump' returns only a Manhole sensor flag, a minigame name string and a worldmap SFX enum. The candidate tables at src/Bases/Player/PlayerBase.cpp:4-6 (+-0x3000/0x3800/0x4000 = 12/14/16 px, selected by powerup) are NOT confirmed as jump velocities: the function has no caller in src/ and its type is i16 while velocities are i32. Do not use them as jump power.
unknown.per_species_gravity: Only StageEntity (default), Coin and Manhole are evidenced. ~300 actor classes are one-line stubs; their gravity is inherited from the StageEntity default unless they override it in code that has not been decompiled. Absence here is unknown, not zero.
unknown.level_record_layout: Not represented in this source: src/Bases/StageEntity.cpp contains no file reading and no record loop, and the course section FourCCs (ENRT/SPAW/LVTL/...) occur nowhere in src/, tools/ or lib/. The class that would own it, StageLayout, is a 0xa8f4-byte stub (src/Bases/stubs/StageLayout.hpp:11-19).

actor_identity.table: out/nsmb_object_ids.json -- 342 ids recovered by pairing each 'ActorProfile X_Profile = { Class::create, <id>, <render>, ... }' definition with its '// MainProfileTable slot N | ovMMM | profile @ ADDR' header comment
actor_identity.validation: 320 of 342 cross-checked against the comment's slot with zero disagreements; 22 have no comment; no id is claimed by two classes. Coverage is partial: Goomba, Koopa and Piranha Plant have no profile line in this checkout.
